Evaluate this alternative way of studying smells and facial attractiveness in practical terms

text: Demattè et al (smells and facial attractiveness) conducted a laboratory experiment on female
college students. An alternative method to investigate this would be to conduct a field experiment,
for example, at a social event.

Section B (20 marks)
Answer one question from this section.

text: Maguire et al investigated the brain activity of taxi drivers using a PET scanner.
